instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a two-story campus mixed-use building whose flat roof, south horizontal shading, and regular bay rhythm define the architectural order. The school wants it to become a comprehensive energy-retrofit prototype. Preserve the stacked floors and long-facade rhythm, organize office, learning, laboratory, and support spaces, and add south daylight control, roof photovoltaics, water use, exterior lighting, envelope constructions, and key energy reporting. The added systems should support the overall retrofit goal rather than read as isolated objects. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
